text:
maria: FYI escalating — customer (AcmeCorp) in prod is hitting tool call failures across py/ts SDKs. Tool selector is choosing text-summarizer instead of pdf-attachment-parser when a 'file' arg is provided as empty/nullable bytes. Repro attached below. @josh-support please triage. :eyes:

josh-support: Which SDK versions, request id, and raw body please?

maria: SDKs: python 0.12.3, js 0.11.8. request_id: req_0A12BC34. Raw body from client (TS):
```
{ "tool": "parse_pdf", "args": { "file": "" } }
```
Python client sends:
```
{ "tool": "parse_pdf", "args": { } }
```
Server log shows selection:
```
[tool_selector] req=req_0A12BC34 matched_tool=text_summarizer reason=arg_type(file)=string
```

carla-qa: So TS is serializing an empty Uint8Array -> "" and Python omits None. The selector treats presence+type as signal for 'text' tool.

oliver-eng: This matches a regression I saw: SDKs don't normalize nullable bytes. The schema expects base64 bytes or omission for null. Empty-string should be treated as empty bytes but we treat it as text. We need a short-term server fallback to accept empty string as bytes for existing customers.

josh-support: Can you produce minimal repro harness? Also, any differences in Content-Type or header?

maria: Repro script (TS):
```
await client.callTool({ tool: 'parse_pdf', args: { file: new Uint8Array() } })
```
And Python:
```
client.call_tool('parse_pdf', args={ 'file': None })
```

sdk-release-bot: Noted. Creating ticket: ENG-4321 (sdk-serialization-null-bytes) and a server fallback: INF-2147.

oliver-eng: Plan: 1) Hotfix server to accept "" as base64-empty for bytes in tool selector (rollout next hour). 2) Patch TS/Go SDKs to encode empty Uint8Array as null (or base64 of empty string) and add tests. 3) Add matcher tolerance in selector to check 'is_base64' regex.

carla-qa: I'll add automated tests covering python/js/go permutations.

maria: Customer notified; temporary mitigation: suggest client to omit the key when empty. They confirmed workaround works.

josh-support: Assigning to eng oncall for hotfix. cc @oliver-eng

oliver-eng: Oncall deployed server fallback (INF-2147) to canary region. Monitoring for errors.

sdk-release-bot: Patch PRs opened: github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/789, github.com/redwood/sdk-py/pull/456

maria: Thx all — will close after cross-region rollback window.

carla-qa: Verified in canary, behavior fixed. Closing when PRs merge.

maria: Closing — root cause: inconsistent SDK serialization of nullable bytes causing tool selection mismatch. Follow-ups: ENG-4321, INF-2147.
